description.en: Connected vehicle telemetry platform for Volkswagen Group pan-Europe. Microservices in Kotlin and Java 21 on Azure / Kubernetes (AKS), batch processing of 1M+ vehicle events, and secure data exchange via OpenDXM GlobalX.
description.pt: Plataforma de telemetria veicular conectada para o Volkswagen Group na Europa. Microsserviços em Kotlin e Java 21 sobre Azure / Kubernetes (AKS), drenagem de 1M+ eventos e intercâmbio de dados com OpenDXM GlobalX.
description.fr: Plateforme de télémétrie de véhicules connectés pour Volkswagen Group en Europe. Microservices en Kotlin et Java 21 sur Azure / Kubernetes (AKS) et transfert sécurisé OpenDXM GlobalX.
